Sub-series counting their best 3 inside a best-5 season — ISORA 2026, IRC Class 1, Irish and Welsh Coastal

RRS A2.1, changed by ISORA's race schedule: the Wolf's Head season counts the best 5 races, the Irish and Welsh Coastal Series the best 3.

Scoring system: IRC · Discards: The best 5 races count; each fleet discards the rest of the races it sailed.

Irish Coastal discards: The best 3 races count; each fleet discards the rest of the races it sailed.
